Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra
90 days notice.

A focused frontend developer delivering maintainable Angular applications, testable components, and responsive UIs using component-driven design and observables.

Senior Angular Developer, HCLTech — Feb 2023 - Present
Lead development of a customer-facing policy management portal built as an Angular single-page application. Implemented component-level unit tests and snapshot tests using Jest, raising test coverage on core modules from 48% to 86%. Built reactive data flows using RxJS to manage live policy updates and reduced UI latency by 35% through optimized stream handling. Collaborated with product and QA using Jira and Confluence to triage issues and document release notes.

Frontend Engineer, Wipro — Sep 2020 - Jan 2023
Developed modular Angular features for an internal claims processing tool, converting legacy pages into reusable components. Used RxJS to implement observable-driven state and async data loading, improving perceived performance and reducing unnecessary API calls by 40%. Styled responsive interfaces with CSS and authored TypeScript component contracts to enforce consistency. Tracked tasks and coordinated sprints via Jira and documented technical decisions in Confluence.

Skills: Angular, TS, RxJS, CSS, Jest, Jira, Confluence

Education: MCA, Symbiosis
